title: X64 Gcc Polynomial
objective: Make arbitrary-prime polynomial resource witnesses compile cleanly with GCC 13 under -Werror

handoff.summary: Sealed normalized arbitrary-prime polynomial resources now answer zero tests and obtain their leading coefficient directly from the canonical FLINT representation. This avoids GCC 13 false stringop-overread diagnostics from unused array-typed context arguments. The originating Linux x64 lane passed ordinary GCC 13 execution and sanitizer-backed resource lifecycle witnesses before integration.
next_steps: Retain the arbitrary-prime polynomial resource witness in every supported native release build.
